sources.label: Clean, ad-free Morphe patches for popular Android apps.
sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Hide playback controls at stream open
Hides playback controls when a stream opens or switches fullscreen. Tap the video to show them.
Stops background bandwidth sharing, removes ads, and hides the player app logo on 7.4.

sources.label: Beyonder Morphe patches
sources.author: Beyonder
patch_list: Disables the native tamper check that makes a re-signed build fail to decrypt the server configuration on startup.
Removes the sponsor ads (banner and gate screens) and the full-screen ads. The locked channel dialog is kept.
Disables the CashRaven P2P bandwidth-sharing SDK: no opt-in, no background sharing service, no restart on boot, and the sharing menu entry is hidden.
Removes the boot-persistence, advertising-ID, install-referrer and package-query permissions the patched build no longer needs.
